name: Eve
overview: Eve is the first woman created by God, formed from Adam's rib to be his companion and helper. She is female and holds a unique place in Scripture as the mother of all living. No specific tribe or additional notes are recorded about her beyond her foundational role in the human story.
namesAndTitles: The name Eve means "living one," reflecting her role as the mother of all living. This proper name is recorded in Genesis 3:20 and 2 Corinthians 11:3, though it was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Eve is explicitly identified as the wife of Adam and the mother of Cain and Abel. She is also inferred to be the mother of Seth. These relationships establish her as the progenitor of the human race alongside Adam.
scriptureSignificance: Eve is central to the biblical narrative as the first woman and the partner of Adam, created to complete humanity. Her decision to eat the forbidden fruit, influenced by deception, marks the entrance of sin into the world. Despite this, she is honored as the mother of all living and is connected to the promise of redemption through her offspring, ultimately fulfilled in Christ.
